@patch.source:

    exp.Set(

        expressions=self._parse_csv(self._parse_id_var),

    )
),

@map.source:
"DATABASE": lambda self: (
    self.expression(exp.DatabaseProperty())
    if self._curr and self._curr.text.upper() == "ROLE"
    else None
),

"SECURITY": lambda self: (
    self.expression(exp.SecurityIntegrationProperty())
    if self._curr and self._curr.text.upper() == "INTEGRATION"
    else None
),

),

),

    f"{'TRY_' if e.args.get('safe') else ''}DECRYPT",

    e.args.get("passphrase"),
    e.args.get("aad"),
    e.args.get("encryption_method"),
),

exp.DecryptRaw: lambda self, e: self.func(
    f"{'TRY_' if e.args.get('safe') else ''}DECRYPT_RAW",

    e.args.get("aad"),
    e.args.get("encryption_method"),
    e.args.get("aead"),
),

    "ARRAY_GENERATE_RANGE",

    e.args["end"] if e.args.get("is_end_exclusive") else e.args["end"] + 1,
    e.args.get("step"),
),
